sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Agent
    participant API as Adashi Design API
    participant Store as Formal Design Workspace Store
    Agent->>API: Read complete editable document
    API->>Store: Read canonical document and compute its content hash
    Store-->>API: Document identity, document, readToken
    API-->>Agent: Complete document and opaque readToken
    Agent->>Agent: Apply intended edits to the read document
    Agent->>API: Save document identity, proposed content, readToken
    API->>Store: Begin transaction and compare current document hash
    alt Token is out of date
        Store-->>API: Same-snapshot currentDocument and fresh readToken
        API->>Store: End transaction without storing changes
        API-->>Agent: Error out_of_date, stored false, currentDocument, readToken
        Note over API,Agent: Merge your intended changes into currentDocument and retry with its readToken
        Agent->>Agent: Merge intended edits with currentDocument
        Agent->>API: Retry merged content with returned readToken
        Note over Agent,Store: Every retry repeats the atomic token and validation checks
    else Token matches
        API->>Store: Validate formal syntax, references, and dependencies
        alt Invalid content
            API->>Store: Roll back all attempted changes
            API-->>Agent: Detailed validation error with stored false
        else Equivalent content
            API->>Store: End without changing document or cursor
            API-->>Agent: No-change result and current readToken
        else Changed and valid
            API->>Store: Commit content, regenerate derived source, bump notification cursor
            Store-->>API: New document readToken
            API-->>Agent: Stored result and new readToken
        end
    end
    Note over Agent,Store: Creates need an absent identity and no previous token
    Note over API,Store: Multi-document saves check every affected document and commit all or nothing
    Note over API,Store: Independent documents never share a project-wide token

data.title: Design document hash and conflict merge contract
